SELECT mold_id AS moldId, COUNT(1) AS repairFrequency, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, start_time, end_time) / 3600.0) AS avgRepairDurationHours FROM repair_records WHERE start_time >= #{start} AND start_time <= #{end} AND status != 1 AND start_time IS NOT NULL
AND mold_id IN
#{moldId}
GROUP BY mold_id

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(actual_end_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
DATE_FORMAT( DATE_SUB(DATE(actual_end_time), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(actual_end_time)) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d' )
DATE_FORMAT(actual_end_time, '%Y-%m-01')
AS bucketKey, COUNT(1) AS usageCount, SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, actual_start_time, actual_end_time) / 3600.0) AS productionHours FROM mold_usage_records WHERE status = 3 AND actual_start_time IS NOT NULL AND actual_end_time IS NOT NULL AND actual_end_time >= #{start} AND actual_end_time <= #{end}
AND mold_id = #{moldId}
GROUP BY bucketKey ORDER BY bucketKey

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(start_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
DATE_FORMAT( DATE_SUB(DATE(start_time), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(start_time)) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d' )
DATE_FORMAT(start_time, '%Y-%m-01')
AS bucketKey, COUNT(1) AS repairCount, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, start_time, end_time) / 3600.0) AS avgRepairDurationHours FROM repair_records WHERE status != 1 AND start_time IS NOT NULL AND start_time >= #{start} AND start_time <= #{end}
AND mold_id = #{moldId}
GROUP BY bucketKey ORDER BY bucketKey

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(actual_end_time, created_at), '%Y-%m-%d')
DATE_FORMAT( DATE_SUB(DATE(COALESCE(actual_end_time, created_at)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(COALESCE(actual_end_time, created_at))) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d' )
DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(actual_end_time, created_at), '%Y-%m-01')
AS bucketKey, COUNT(1) AS maintenanceCount FROM maintenance_logs WHERE COALESCE(actual_end_time, created_at) >= #{start} AND COALESCE(actual_end_time, created_at) <= #{end}
AND mold_id = #{moldId}
GROUP BY bucketKey ORDER BY bucketKey
